race.comment: LEICA QUEEN (6) is the one to beat after making up good ground for fifth at this track in a BM58 over 1280m on soft going, after being unwanted in the market. She has a previous win around 1450m and gets the winning rider back aboard. Finds a winnable race. SIGSALY (8) is the main danger after a much sharper third in a BM58 over 1600m at Scone, beaten just over two lengths at long odds, though the 10-day back-up and slight drop in trip are the balancing points. Will be strong late. HONEST DOLL (4) surprised fresh in a Maiden at Armidale over 1400m after striking some trouble. Expected to go on with it now with the 3kg claim. DON'T TELL POLLY (2) resumes off two trials after finishing her last campaign in BM58 and BM72 races. Likely to get back early and can make her presence felt fresh.
